officialText: 8. Cementitious materials. Any change to cementitious materials shall require an additional laboratory testing trial batch. The new cementitious material shall maintain the same air and water cementitious ratio (w/cm) as the original mix and meet the strength requirements of ACI 301, Table 4.2.3.3 b. Approval of the registered design professional of record and submittal of data from either a three- or seven-day compressive strength test shall be required prior to the placement of concrete.
